items.event_title: Micron AI-fueled forecast beats estimates as contracted backlog swells
items.news_summary: Micron forecast fiscal Q1 revenue of $61.5B plus/minus $1.5B versus $57.02B consensus and adjusted EPS of $38.15 plus/minus $1 versus $35.40 expected. Customer commitments under long-term supply agreements rose to $32B from $22B in June and remaining performance obligations rose to about $150B from roughly $100B last quarter.

items.selection_reason: Fresh earnings/guidance catalyst with unusually strong contracted demand and direct read-through to AI infrastructure spending.
